Row.Text: Lets a Wonder be built on an urban tile whose buildings are all from an earlier age. Pick the tile on the Wonder placement screen: the old buildings are cleared, the walls stay, the displaced citizens are yours to place through the usual Grow City prompt, and the Wonder rises on a proper Wonder district. If the game refuses the site after all, the tile is put back. No database changes; Wonders stay exactly as they are.
{1_Buildings} will be cleared to build {2_Wonder} here.
You will be asked where the {1_Num} displaced {1_Num: plural 1?citizen; other?citizens;} settle.
